pairs.subject: hitl-approval
pairs.evidence: lib/agent/reviewerCommand.ts:37 The headless agy reviewer runs under an allow-everything profile and is contained only by workspace isolation, while the claude writer and reviewer run a closed allowlist with dontAsk and no prompts; one engine of the seam is therefore open rather than fail-closed.

techniques.evidence: lib/agent/reviewerCommand.ts:37 agy gets the open policy; reviewerEngines.ts:47 admits writes are not stopped by flag. The claude profile (agentArgs.ts:40, dontAsk plus a closed allowlist at :25) is conformant.
lib/agent/cliSeam.ts:26 No author-written agent definition or settings file is loaded at all, so no author/user rule merge happens.

pairs.registryProposal: fail-closed-profile-for-headless has no rule for a vendor CLI whose headless mode cannot express a narrow allow (agy auto-denies read_url unless every permission is skipped); it should say whether workspace isolation plus recorded writes is an acceptable compensating control or remains a deviation.
